profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Milyli
profile.summary: An excellent problem solver with significant experience in technical, analytical and abstract challenges. Devotes self to projects while maintaining communication with teammates. Is constantly improving programming abilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed major features in C# for Blackout, Milyli’s flagship product to perform millions of text matching and redaction operations on Excel, PDF and imaged documents
Wrote models and migrations for applications’ SQL persistence layer
Developed MVC front end for applications’ user and API interactions
Engineered prototype of an application on the Relativity platform, laying the groundwork for the product Chronicle
Mentored new teammates, helping build their understanding of our codebase
Drove team discussions on application design, solution implementation and code ergonomics
Wrote tasks for user stories as part of our Agile processes
Led a major refactor of application's display logic into Vue
Converted style sheets to SCSS, for DRY-er, more maintainable use
Built a Slack bot in Swift on the Vapor framework to engage team in the build process

positions.description: Developed math models for slot games. Developed simulations of math models and analyzed game statistics. Worked with game designers, artists and engineers to produce high quality slot content.

projects.title: Coupleteer
projects.description: Coupleteer is a Java-based couplet generator. It combines the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary and WordHoard's tagged Shakespeare corpus to produce rhyming couplets in iambic pentameter.
